summary: Amanita Design adventure entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Machinarium

primary.why: Machinarium is a point-and-click puzzle adventure and the current PC release is the cleanest capture route. Mobile and console ports are valid access routes, but PC preserves pointer input, resolution/capture control, and easy soundtrack/art-book documentation where included.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, resolution/window mode, input device, hint-book use, language, bonus materials, and whether mobile/console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting alternate input or platform availability.
secondary.why: PC is the better archive capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record hint-book use, language, input device, and storefront/build.
